summary: Frontend testing of Redcat Eyewear overhaul iteration. Tested homepage (light mode, hero copy, no marquee, product cards), theme toggle, navbar/footer dark persistence, product page (BEAST variant image switching), and ColorBoost text removal.

minor.issue: Cyan Matte Metallic frame only has one variant (Cyan Matte Metallic + CarbonGlo™ Oil Slick Mirror). No Cyan + BronzeGlo™ Red Mirror variant exists. This causes the variant switcher to fall back to variants[0] (Black Matte) when user selects Cyan frame while BronzeGlo lens is active - gallery images don't update to cyan-specific photos.

ui_bugs.issue: Footer still has 'Hue ColorBoost lens technology' text - should be 'color-tuned lens technology'
Stats label under 'Up to 37%' still says 'Color boost' - should be updated to match color-tuned technology branding

integration_issues.flow: Product page variant switching (BEAST - Frame Color)
integration_issues.issue: Selecting 'Cyan Matte Metallic' frame color does NOT update gallery images. Root cause: Product.jsx falls back to variants[0] when no exact variant match found (Cyan + BronzeGlo™ Red Mirror doesn't exist in data). The backend only has Cyan paired with CarbonGlo™ Oil Slick Mirror. Fix: When user selects a frame color, auto-update lens type to the first available lens for that frame (or implement smart variant fallback that at least matches on frame color).

action_items: Fix Footer.jsx line 39: Replace 'Hue ColorBoost lens technology' with 'color-tuned lens technology'
Fix Home.jsx line 161: Replace 'Color boost' stat label with 'Color-tuned' or similar

Fix Product.jsx variant fallback logic: When selected options don't match any variant exactly, find the closest variant by frame color alone (not fall back to variants[0]). This ensures gallery updates when user picks a frame color. OR add linked option selection so picking Cyan frame auto-updates lens to the only lens that exists for Cyan (CarbonGlo™ Oil Slick Mirror).
Backend: Add more variant combinations for Cyan Matte Metallic OR ensure frontend smart-selects compatible lens when frame changes
critical_code_review_comments: Product.jsx useMemo currentVariant: Falls back to variants[0] when no exact match — should fall back to first variant with matching Frame Color instead. This is the root cause of broken Cyan variant image switching.
Home.jsx: 'Color boost' stat label at line 161 is a leftover from old branding
passed_tests: Homepage loads with white background for content sections in light mode
Hero section stays dark with correct updated copy containing 'color-tuned lens technology'
No scrolling marquee exists on the homepage
Navbar has light/dark mode toggle (Moon/Sun icons)
Theme toggle switches dark class on documentElement
Product page loads with white background
Product page shows 4 thumbnails for Black Matte variant
Navbar and footer always stay dark
failed_tests: Variant image switching: Selecting Cyan Matte Metallic frame shows Black Matte images (falls back to variants[0])
ColorBoost text not fully removed: Still present in Footer and stats label
context_for_next_testing_agent: Main issues: (1) Footer.jsx line 39 has 'ColorBoost' text. (2) Home.jsx line 161 has 'Color boost' stat label. (3) BEAST product page - selecting Cyan Matte Metallic frame doesn't update gallery to cyan images because Product.jsx falls back to variants[0] when exact option combo not found. The fix is to make variant fallback match on Frame Color alone. Test BEAST at /products/beast by selecting Cyan Matte Metallic swatch and verify gallery updates to cyan-specific images.

rca_of_variant_issue.root_cause: Product.jsx currentVariant useMemo uses strict ALL options matching. Backend only has one Cyan variant (Cyan Matte Metallic + CarbonGlo™ Oil Slick Mirror). When user selects Cyan frame while lens stays at BronzeGlo™ Red Mirror, no variant matches, so code falls back to variants[0] (Black Matte).
rca_of_variant_issue.reproduction: Go to /products/beast, ensure Lens Type is BronzeGlo™ Red Mirror, click Cyan Matte Metallic swatch - gallery stays on Black Matte images
rca_of_variant_issue.fix: In Product.jsx, change the fallback from `|| product.variants[0]` to `|| product.variants.find(v => v.selectedOptions.some(o => o.name === 'Frame Color' && o.value === selectedOptions['Frame Color'])) || product.variants[0]`. Also consider auto-updating incompatible lens option when frame is changed.
